newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: MOTORCYCLING-OKADA HURT IN PRACTICE CRASH.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-OKADA HURT IN PRACTICE CRASH.

text.p: Japanese 500cc Honda rider Tadayuki Okada crashed heavily on Saturday during qualifying for the Austrian Grand Prix.
Initial reports from the A1-Ring said Okada had escaped with bruising to the left hip. He was undergoing an X-ray examination.

The accident occurred three minutes before the end of the hour-long session and only two minutes after Okada had lost pole position for Sunday's race to team mate and world champion Michael Doohan of Australia.
